cisa_kev_entries.short_description: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Sunhillo SureLine OS Command Injection Vulnerablity
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Sunhillo SureLine contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to cause a denial-of-service or utilize the device for persistence on the network via shell metacharacters in ipAddr or dnsAddr in /cgi/networkDiag.cgi.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply updates per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if updates are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability in the way that the application manages keys used for ViewState integrity verification. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to forge ViewState payloads for server-side deserialization, allowing for remote code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Hardcoded Credential Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a time-of-check/time-of-use (TOCTOU) memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker with read and write capabilities to bypass Pointer Authentication.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Type Confusion Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Sophos Firewall Code Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Jenkins Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Jenkins contains a remote code execution vulnerability. This vulnerability that could allowed attackers to transfer a serialized Java SignedObject object to the remoting-based Jenkins CLI, that would be deserialized using a new ObjectInputStream, bypassing the existing blocklist-based protection mechanism.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Edimax IC-7100 IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Edimax IC-7100 IP camera contains an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper input sanitization that allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution via specially crafted requests. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SAP Commerce Cloud Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SAP Commerce Cloud (formerly known as Hybris) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within the mediaconversion and virtualjdbc extension that allows for code injection.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web component that allows an attacker to access restricted resources by bypassing control checks. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2024-21887, a command injection vulnerability.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Please apply mitigations per vendor instructions. For more information, please see: https://forums.ivanti.com/s/article/KB-CVE-2023-46805-Authentication-Bypass-CVE-2024-21887-Command-Injection-for-Ivanti-Connect-Secure-and-Ivanti-Policy-Secure-Gateways?language=en_US ;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-46805

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Google Chromium contains a type confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak sensitive information.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Adobe Flash Player Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Adobe Flash Player contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in the Firefox sandbox that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue utilization of the product.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: QNAP VioStor NVR OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: QNAP VioStar NVR contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Multiple Ruckus Wireless Products CSRF and RCE Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ruckus Wireless Access Point (AP) software contains an unspecified vulnerability in the web services component. If the web services component is enabled on the AP, an attacker can perform cross-site request forgery (CSRF) or remote code execution (RCE). This vulnerability impacts Ruckus ZoneDirector, SmartZone, and Solo APs.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply updates per vendor instructions or disconnect product if it is end-of-life.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Git Link Following Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Git contains a link following vulnerability that stems from Git’s inconsistent handling of carriage return characters in configuration files.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/git/git/security/advisories/GHSA-vwqx-4fm8-6qc9 ; https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2025:13933 ; https://alas.aws.amazon.com/AL2/ALAS2-2025-2941.html ; https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2025-11534.html ; https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-48384 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-48384

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server Special Element Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server contains a special element injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to inject Spring templates into properties files, allowing for arbitrary command execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Kingsoft WPS Office Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: While CISA cannot confirm the effectiveness of patches at this time, it is recommended that mitigations be applied per vendor instructions if available. If these instructions cannot be located or if mitigations are unavailable, discontinue the use of the product.;   https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-7262

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ownCloud graphapi Information Disclosure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Security Control Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a security control bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to certain restricted functionality.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains a command injection vulnerability in the cgi-bin/ddns_enc.cgi. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the SSLVPN authentication mechanism that allows a remote attacker to bypass authentication.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers limited read access to certain files, which can lead to code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to user.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block (SMBv1) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Sangoma FreePBX Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Sangoma FreePBX contains an improper authentication vulnerability that potentially allows unauthorized users to bypass password authentication and access services provided by the FreePBX admin.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft SharePoint Server on-premises contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-53771. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Disconnect public-facing versions of SharePoint Server that have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) to include SharePoint Server 2013 and earlier versions. For supported versions, please follow the mitigations according to CISA (URL listed below in Notes) and vendor instructions (URL listed below in Notes). Adhere to the applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are not available.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Outlook Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Outlook contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability would allow an attacker to bypass the Office Protected View and open in editing mode rather than protected mode.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple macOS Unspecified Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple macOS contains an unspecified logic issue in System Preferences that may allow a malicious application to bypass Gatekeeper checks.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Server contain an Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Malicious DNS Packet Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in parsing and logging malicious DNS packets in the DNS Security feature that, when exploited, allows an unauthenticated attacker to remotely reboot the firewall. Repeated attempts to trigger this condition will cause the firewall to enter maintenance mode.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Excel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Excel when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Active Management Technology (AMT), Small Business Technology (SBT), and Standard Manageability
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Intel Active Management Technology (AMT), Small Business Technology (SBT), and Standard Manageability Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Intel products contain a vulnerability which can allow attackers to perform privilege escalation.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Please adhere to CISA’s guidelines to assess exposure and mitigate risks associated with Cisco SD-WAN devices as outlined in CISA’s Emergency Directive 26-03 (URL listed below in Notes) and CISA’s Hunt & Hardening Guidance for Cisco SD-WAN Devices (URL listed below in Notes). Adhere to the applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are not available.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link Routers Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link Routers contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Zimbra Collaboration contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the CalendarInvite feature of the Zimbra webmail classic user interface. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability via an email message containing a crafted calendar header, leading to the execution of arbitrary JavaScript code.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Oracle Java SE Unspecified Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle Java SE allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to 2D

cisa_kev_entries.product: IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS and XE Software Internet Key Exchange Version 1 Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the implementation of Internet Key Exchange Version 1 (IKEv1) functionality in Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SimpleHelp Missing Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Gladinet Triofox Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Gladinet Triofox contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows access to initial setup pages even after setup is complete.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A memory corruption vulnerability in Apple iOS kernel allows attackers to execute code in a privileged context or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted application.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Sitecore XP Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Sitcore XP contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: In Drupal Core, some field types do not properly sanitize data from non-form sources. This can lead to arbitrary PHP code execution in some cases.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS Software Common Industrial Protocol Request Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: There is a vulnerability in the implementation of the Common Industrial Protocol (CIP) feature in Cisco IOS could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial of service.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: VMware SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud contains a command injection vulnerability in the local web UI component. Successful exploitation of this issue could result in remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WSO2 Multiple Products Unrestrictive Upload of File Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple WSO2 products allow for unrestricted file upload, resulting in remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows SMB Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS Mail contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which may allow memory modification or application termination when processing a maliciously crafted mail message.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiWeb SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized SQL code or commands via crafted HTTP or HTTPs requests.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Webkit Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/59673137c45ac2bcfad1170d954347c1a17ab949 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-31125

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiOS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Fileserver web application in Apache ActiveMQ allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary files via an HTTP PUT followed by an HTTP MOVE request

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability resulting from a pdkinstall development plugin being incorrectly enabled in release builds.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow ; https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/releases/tag/v1.9.3; https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/issues/11465#event-25774545848 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-34291

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SonicWall SMA1000 Missing Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SonicWall SMA1000 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation appliance management console (AMC) of affected devices.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Check for signs of potential compromise on all internet accessible SonicWall SMA1000 instances after applying mitigations. For more information please see: https://psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2025-0019 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-40602

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption due to unauthorized command execution in GPU micronode while executing specific sequence of commands.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Please check with specific vendors (OEMs,) for information on patching status. For more information, please see: https://docs.qualcomm.com/product/publicresources/securitybulletin/june-2025-bulletin.html ;   https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-21479

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Edge Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft XML Core Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft XML Core Services (MSXML) improperly handles objects in memory, allowing attackers to test for files on disk via a crafted web site.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Denial-of-Service Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS Memory Corruption Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the implementation of a protocol in Cisco Integrated Services Routers Generation 2 (ISR G2) Routers running Cisco IOS could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial of service.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chrome Skia Integer Overflow Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium Intents Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DIR-645 Router Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability that may allow an attacker to achieve path traversal and remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Trend Micro Apex One (On-Premise) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Please adhere to Cisco's guidelines to assess exposure and mitigate risks. Check for signs of potential compromise on all internet accessible Cisco products affected by this vulnerability. Apply any final mitigations provided by the vendor as soon as they become available. For more information please see: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-sma-attack-N9bf4 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-20393

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Silverlight Double Dereference Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during HTML object rendering, which allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Silverlight application.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Microsoft JScript nd VBScript engines, as used in Internet Explorer and other products, allow attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ChakraCore Scripting Engine Type Confusion Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The ChakraCore scripting engine contains a type confusion vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: GNU Bourne-Again Shell (Bash) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: GNU Bash through 4.3 processes trailing strings after function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to execute code.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Graphics Device Interface (GDI) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Graphics Device Interface (GDI) in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Oracle Java SE Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The default Java security properties configuration did not restrict access to the com.sun.org.glassfish.external and com.sun.org.glassfish.gmbal packages. An untrusted Java application or applet could use these flaws to bypass Java sandbox restrictions.

cisa_kev_entries.product: IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the Smart Install feature of Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a reload of an affected device, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Exchange Server Information Disclosure
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to steal email traffic from target.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) SNMP Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) code of Cisco ASA software could allow an attacker to cause a reload of the affected system or to remotely execute code.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DIR-610 Devices Remote Command Execution

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Information Disclosure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: An information disclosure vulnerability exists when Internet Explorer improperly handles objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could test for the presence of files on disk.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the implementation of Network Address Translation (NAT) functionality in Cisco IOS could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial of service.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles calls to Win32k.sys. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run remote code in the security context of the local system.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Linux Kernel Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Linux Kernel contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Reliable Datagram Sockets (RDS) protocol implementation that allows local users to gain privileges via crafted use of the sendmsg and recvmsg system calls.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Service Location Protocol (SLP) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or disable SLP service or port 427/UDP on all systems running on untrusted networks, including those directly connected to the Internet.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. Please check with specific vendors for information on the patching status. For more information please see https://www.bitsight.com/blog/new-high-severity-vulnerability-cve-2023-29552-discovered-service-location-protocol-slp and https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2023/04/25/abuse-service-location-protocol-may-lead-dos-attacks.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-29552

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog contains a privilege escalation vulnerability, allowing attackers to run processes in an elevated context.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Skype for Business Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Skype for Business contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Unspecified Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a non-privileged user to achieve write access to read-only memory pages.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SAP NetWeaver Information Disclosure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Universal Worklist Configuration in SAP NetWeaver AS JAVA 7.4 allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive user information via a crafted HTTP request.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Roundcube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to manipulate data via a malicious XML attachment.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: IBM Aspera Faspex Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: IBM Aspera Faspex could allow a remote attacker to execute code on the system, caused by a YAML deserialization flaw.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer Installer Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer installer contains a malicious version of ffmpeg.exe, named fffmpeg.exe (SHA256: 421a4ad2615941b177b6ec4ab5e239c14e62af2ab07c6df1741e2a62223223c4). When run, this creates a backdoor connection to a malicious C2 server.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Please follow the vendor’s instructions as outlined in the public statements at https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/2024/05/23/cve-2024-4978-backdoored-justice-av-solutions-viewer-software-used-in-apparent-supply-chain-attack#remediation and https://www.javs.com/downloads;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-4978

cisa_kev_entries.product: Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense contain an unauthorized access vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct a brute force attack in an attempt to identify valid username and password combinations or establish a clientless SSL VPN session with an unauthorized user.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions for group-lock and vpn-simultaneous-logins or discontinue use of the product for unsupported devices.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Oracle E-Business Suite Unspecified Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Web Applications Desktop Integrator.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ProjectSend Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: ProjectSend contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to enable unauthorized modification of the application's configuration via crafted HTTP requests to options.php. cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
